info.title: Dub Universal API
info.description: Create short links and track partner conversions and analytics

post.description: Creates links in Dub in bulk.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

links[].description: JSON array of link objects. Each item must include `url`. Common optional keys include `domain`, `key`, `title`, `externalId`, `tagIds`, `tagNames`, `folderId`, `comments`, and `expiresAt`.

links[].url.description: Destination URL for this link row. Required by Dub for each link object.

links[].key.description: Custom short-link slug for this row.

links[].tagIds[].description: Tag IDs assigned to this row.

links[].tagNames[].description: Tag names assigned to this row.

links[].folderId.description: Folder ID assigned to this row.

links[].expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 expiration timestamp for this row.

put.description: Updates links in Dub in bulk.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

linkIds[].description: IDs of the links to update. Use this field or `External IDs` to choose the target links.

data.description: Fields in this section are applied to every selected link.

externalIds[].description: External IDs of the links to update. Use this field or `Target Link IDs` to choose the target links.

data.url.description: Updated destination URL applied to every selected link in this batch.

data.title.description: Updated title applied to every selected link in this batch.

data.description.description: Updated description applied to every selected link in this batch.

data.archived.description: Archive or unarchive every selected link.

data.trackConversion.description: Enable or disable conversion tracking for every selected link.

data.tagIds[].description: Tag IDs to assign to every selected link.

data.tagNames[].description: Tag names to assign to every selected link.

data.folderId.description: Folder ID to assign to every selected link.

data.comments.description: Comments applied to every selected link.

data.expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 expiration timestamp applied to every selected link.

data.expiredUrl.description: Destination URL to use after expiration for every selected link.

data.publicStats.description: Make stats public or private for every selected link.

data.utmSource.description: UTM source applied to every selected link.

data.utmMedium.description: UTM medium applied to every selected link.

data.utmCampaign.description: UTM campaign applied to every selected link.

data.utmTerm.description: UTM term applied to every selected link.

data.utmContent.description: UTM content applied to every selected link.
